Name: Sir Robert's Cutie Patootie Flowers
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This mod offers you a small selection of flowers for your decorating pleasure. Each image has additonal vases and pots via Alternative Textures. The flowers are supposed to be zinnias, cosmos, poppies, dahlias, and daisies. Unfortunately, I have failed to create the perfect pixel art marigold, which was supposed to be the first image, but I'm still trying. I simply cannot grasp the right combination of colors--it is either too orange or too yellow and looks ridiculous in the game. If anyone has suggestions, please let me know![/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]In the meantime, I think I have enough flower blossom shapes, which means I can go wild & crazy with different colors in upcoming mods. That's my favorite part about creating my own mods--I get to change the colors & the vases around as much as I desire. Plus, I'll continue trying to create the perfect marigold...[/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. When you play the game, the images will be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Images #1 through #10 can be placed upon the majority of [u]end tables[/u] in the game. You will notice that images # 2 and #3 have two slightly different versions...that is because I liked the both so much and couldn't decide which one to use.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #11 have been moved up a few pixels and can be placed upon [u]countertops[/u]. I use the countertops from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen[/url] by Platinum Cats or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/url] by lululovely. (Alas, they don't fit on her most recent kitchen mod).[/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]All the end tables in the pictures are from mods made by Platinum Cats or lululovely. I also used end tables from the furniture catalog in the game. The countertops are also by Platinum Cats and lululovely.[/size][/color]
